text: 中国人民银行行长潘功胜会见了香港特别行政区政府财政司司长陈茂波、财经事务及库务局局长许正宇，香港金融管理局总裁余伟文，香港证券及期货事务监察委员会行政总裁梁凤仪。双方就当前宏观经济与金融形势，巩固提升香港国际金融中心地位，深化内地与香港金融市场互联互通，加强香港离岸人民币市场建设等共同关心的议题交换了意见。（中国央行微信公号）
text_en: PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng met with Hong Kong SAR Government Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po, Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui Ching-yu, Hong Kong Monetary Authority Chief Executive Eddie Yue Wai-man, and Securities and Futures Commission Chief Executive Officer Julia Leung Fung-yee. The two sides exchanged views on issues of common interest, including the current macroeconomic and financial situation, consolidating and enhancing Hong Kong's status as an international financial center, deepening mutual access between the mainland and Hong Kong financial markets, and strengthening the development of Hong Kong's offshore RMB market. (PBOC WeChat official account)
